note: Courses whose eCampus parallel groups are parts of one course, not alternatives. Indices are parsed groups (groups with appointments), in eCampus order. Groups not in pick are attended by everyone; the student takes one pick group (empty: all groups together); slots are groups whose weekly series are alternative times of one session. groups is the expected group count: if eCampus changes it, the scraper warns and leaves the course alone. Applied by applyGroupParts in catalog.js.
